zh: 2 的非负整数次幂一定是正数，所以先把 0 和所有负数排除。剩下的正数里，2 的幂在二进制下恰好只有一个 1。
对只有一个 1 的正数 n，n−1 会把这一位变成 0、把它右边的位全变成 1，于是 n 与 n−1 没有公共的 1，按位与为 0；反过来，按位与为 0 时 n 只可能有一个 1。
读入 n（用 64 位整数更稳妥）。若 n>0 且 (n & (n−1)) = 0，输出 1，否则输出 0。1=2⁰ 也满足条件。
en: A non-negative integer power of 2 is always positive, so rule out 0 and every negative number first. Among the remaining positive numbers, a power of 2 has exactly one 1 bit in binary.

For a positive n with a single 1 bit, n - 1 turns that bit into 0 and every bit to its right into 1, so n and n - 1 share no 1 bits and their bitwise AND is 0; conversely, if the AND is 0, n can only have one 1 bit.
Read n (a 64-bit integer is the safe choice). Output 1 if n > 0 and (n & (n - 1)) = 0, otherwise output 0. Note that 1 = 2^0 satisfies the condition.

explanationEn:
## Approach

First rule out non-positive numbers. For a positive n, if n is a power of 2, its binary form has a single 1 bit; n−1 turns that bit into 0 and every bit to its right into 1, so n&(n−1)=0. Conversely, when this equation holds, n can have only one set bit.

## Proof of Correctness

n>0 and n&(n−1)=0 holds if and only if the binary form of n contains exactly one 1 bit, which is exactly equivalent to n=2^k (k≥0).

## Complexity

Time O(1), space O(1).
